name: novel-to-game
description: A source-grounded 7-skill novel-to-game workflow covering gameable deconstruction, concept selection, world and art design, building a candidate for the target runtime, and evidence-based QA. 有原著依据的 7-skill 小说改编游戏工作流，覆盖可游戏化拆解、概念选择、世界与美术设计、面向指定运行环境的候选版本构建，以及基于运行证据的 QA。
